posts.name: jffdougan
posts.cooked:
Ronway:

I am announcing that my match will begin! I am playing solo, using the five heroes that have gone unselected so far (Absolute Zero, Omnitron-X, Haka, Ra, and Chrono-Ranger for those who want to know). And decided to use The Final Wasteland, because according to Wizard of Oz, Kansas is nothing but a wasteland anyways.

I thought hard about using Tronx. He's probably my favorite support character. I was really surprised that the Grasshopper didn't use AZ, since that was his favorite character for a long time. (He got a poster print of AZ's character card as a present from points way far north last Christmas, with the help and permission of Christopher & Adam. I think there's even a pic in their Twitter stream.)

Edit to add: In the end, I tried to keep my two heroes simple to play, because I was running them and the villain and environment turns. If we'd had somebody else playing with us, I probably would have used Tronx.

Further adding: I ran Knyfe & Wraith, he ran GI Bunker & DW Expat. I can't recall if he got a 4 power Unload in the "official" game or in the one we played against Ambuscade as a warm-up, but it went Aim, Tac Shotgun, Submachine Gun, Pride, Prejudice (as a freebie from Pride). he was pretty impressed by that.
